title: Lambda Error Rate Spike – Root Cause Diagnosis and Fix
description: Diagnose Lambda errors by reading error pattern guide from S3. Different error patterns require different actions.

decision_tree.name: Classify Lambda error pattern
decision_tree.instruction: Check CloudWatch logs for error pattern. Match against the error pattern guide to classify.

conditions.note: Force cold start, may also need timeout increase
Restart; memory increase requires human approval
Transient dependency failure – cold start fixes it
Code bug – cannot auto-fix, rollback needed
Concurrency limit hit – needs limit increase

decision_tree.name: Check if previous version is stable
decision_tree.instruction: Before restart, check if a previous stable version exists. If yes and current version has code errors, rollback instead of restart.

conditions.note: No version to rollback to – restart only

decision_tree.name: Monitor error rate after action
decision_tree.instruction: After restart, monitor error rate for 2 minutes. If error rate does not drop below 5%, escalate.

conditions.note: Error persists post-restart – code issue likely

feedback_notes: Timeout and dependency errors are safe to auto-restart. Code errors always need human rollback.
